title: WPCRL/1450/2013 of Brij Pal AND ANOTHER Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPCRL No. 1450 of 2013
U. C. Dhyani, J.
Mr. Vivek Shukla, Advocate present for
the petitioners.
Mr. Raman Kumar Shah, Deputy
Advocate General alongwith Mr. K.S. Rawal,
Brief Holder present for the State.
Mr. Parikshit Saini, Advocate present for
the private respondents.
Learned counsel for the writ petitioners seek
and is permitted to withdraw present criminal writ
petition. The same is accordingly dismissed as
withdrawn.
 (U. C. Dhyani, J.)
 8.12.2014
SH
